name: Def Leppard Pyromania
reference: Photograph / Rock of Ages: Def Leppard, Pyromania (1983, Battery Studios London, prod. Robert John 'Mutt' Lange)
rig: Steve Clark (Gibson Les Pauls) and Phil Collen -> Marshall master-volume heads (JMP/JCM800 2203 type) -> Marshall 4x12s; Lange's layered, compressed multi-tracking
notes: Amp = 1978 Marshall JMP 2203, the DI capture 'HiSens-Gain9-Mast5-nocab' (the pack's cabbed captures were the research's first pick, but they may already include a cab, so the safe DI one is used) into the rig's 1987 1960A G12T-75 SM57 IR. Align wobble 0.2 for double-tracked width; 480L Large Plate at 15% for Lange's big, polished sound. SW8 LEAD = TS9 push + 380 ms digital solo echo. Unconfirmed [verify]: the exact Marshall models and any pedals Clark/Collen used. Levels are unmeasured. Research: 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`).

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
Marshall 1978 JMP 2203, high input, gain 9 / master 5 (DI)
1987 Marshall 1960A G12T-75, SM57 edge of cone
